fusions.name: From a Dead Stop
fusions.desc: Bursts from stillness into a kick that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 3 seconds, with a 30% chance to leave it [Hindered] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Sudden Uncoiling
fusions.desc: Uncoils into a bucking spin, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, always as a critical hit.

fusions.name: Shed and Bolt
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Your movement speed rises 30% for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Sun-Warmed Flanks
fusions.desc: During the day, your damage rises by 12%.
